notes.title: Buff most bleed related skills
notes.content:
1) Buff most bleed related skills by a lot. Now wyverns should be more viable.
2) Add an option to reroll cards as if the shop is level 10, by sacrificing a level 2 or 3 unit.
3) (new) Made card UI arrangement tighter to prevent it from blocking unit stats on the right

notes.title: QoL update: units will auto combine on bench after buying from shop
notes.content:
1) Now units will auto combine on bench after buying from shop.

But the logic is a bit simplified. It doesn't take into account units on the board, only units on the bench.

E.g. it needs to have other 2 units on the bench to combine. If only 1 unit is on the bench, the other is on the board, it doesn't combine. 

This should improve the QoL a little.

2) Reduced damage of enemy bosses, was too powerful.

3) (new) nerf one of the 3 bosses called UNDEAD LORD, made it melee, made it able to receive negative status effects from attack with passives, e.g. stuns, phase out. Previously it was immune to phys attacks with passives.

notes.title: Improve attack sfx
notes.content: Improve attack sfx, made it shorter and cleaner.

notes.title: Fixed mana drain bug
notes.content: Some enemy units randomly obtained mana draining attacks, noticeably impacted the play experience so I fixed it.

notes.title: Fixed flickering floating text bug
notes.content:
-There was a noticeable issue where some of the floating text were inconsistent/unstable, sometimes flickering. Now it should appear stable.
-Fixed an item, Necklace of Silence, which unintentionally gave units AOE to their attack's.

notes.title: Changed card UI position
notes.content:
-Changed the card UI positioning to the top so that it less obstructive.
-Fixed some localization text

notes.title: Tweaking game balance
notes.content:
Hi folks, just made a minor balance change, this should make magic casting units feel more viable.

-increased mana gain per hit for all units, including enemies
-balanced one of the fishmen (the one providing range immunity)
